title: L-modules are mixed
summary: Let X be the locally symmetric space associated to a reductive $\mathbb Q$-group G and an arithmetic subgroup $Γ$. An L-module M is a combinatorial model of a constructible complex of sheaves on $\widehat X$, the reductive Borel-Serre compactification of X whose strata $X_P$ are indexed by $Γ$-conjugacy classes of parabolic $\mathbb Q$-subgroups P of G. We show that any L-module M is "mixed" in the sense it is an iterated mapping cone of maps to or from shifted weighted cohomology L-modules on strata $X_P$ of $\widehat X$ with coefficients in V, an irreducible regular $L_P$-module.
